name: Kuru Vashar
description: A warrior saved by the nameless orc when a dragon fell on her.

timeline.summary: Three warriors testify that the nameless orc saved their lives, and Alesha rebukes him for thinking his deeds are not glorious enough, telling him to learn his place before choosing a name.
timeline.quote: When you learn what your place among the Mardu is, then you can choose a name.

relations.note: Both fought beside and owe their lives to the same orc.
relations.quote: My friend saved my life, throwing himself onto a dragon's head when it was about to take me in its jaws.

pages_say.description: A warrior saved by the nameless orc when a dragon fell on her.
